title: epan: Replace a bunch of <string_encoding>|ENC_NA
description:
Removes the superfluous ENC_NA from these string encodings.

Update fix-encoding-args.pl script to catch more cases.

commits_data.title: epan: Replace a bunch of <string_encoding>|ENC_NA
commits_data.message:
epan: Replace a bunch of <string_encoding>|ENC_NA

Removes the superfluous ENC_NA from these string encodings.

Update fix-encoding-args.pl script to catch more cases.
